issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently assumes `from` is a file path, not a directory or URL
issues.detail: The fix changes resolution semantics from resolve(s, from) to resolve(from, '..', s). This is correct only when `from` is a file path with a meaningful parent. If `from` is already a directory, a bare filename, or a URL-like string, the '..' segment will produce a wrong base. The invariant ('from' is always a file path whose parent is the source root) needs to be stated in a comment or asserted; otherwise the next caller will break it.

issues.description: readFileSync on every external stack frame is unbounded and uncached
issues.detail: getSourceMap is called per frame during error stacktrace parsing. For an error with N frames touching distinct external files, we do N existsSync + N readFileSync + N convert-source-map parses, with no memoization. Errors with deep stacks in node_modules will reread and reparse the same files repeatedly within one error and across errors. A simple Map<file, SourceMap|undefined> cache scoped to the project (or LRU) would make this asymptotically and practically sane.

issues.description: Synchronous fs in a hot error-reporting path with no size bound
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile does readFileSync on the external module source plus, via fromMapFileSource, on an adjacent .map file. Both can be megabytes (bundled vendor files often are). On a failing test in a large monorepo this can stall the reporter loop noticeably. At minimum, document the assumption that external files are small enough to slurp; ideally guard with a stat-based size cap and fall back to undefined above some threshold.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' for missing maps, which is a silent lie
issues.detail: When the referenced .map file does not exist, the reader returns '{}' so convert-source-map will not throw. This converts a missing-map condition into a valid-but-empty map and discards the diagnostic. A short literate comment is present, but the function should at least surface the miss via debug logging so users debugging bad sourcemaps in node_modules have a thread to pull.

issues.description: Loop invariant / contract of getSourceMap is under-documented
issues.detail: The inline comment says 'external modules only' and relies on `!mod?.transformResult` as the discriminator. The actual invariant — 'a file is external iff Vite has a module node without a transformResult' — is load-bearing and non-obvious; if Vite ever populates an empty transformResult for inlined modules, this silently double-applies source maps. Worth one extra sentence stating the invariant and what breaks if it does not hold.

issues.description: No targeted unit test for the resolvedSources path change
issues.detail: The snapshot test demonstrates end-to-end behavior, which is good, but the actual algorithmic change is one line in DecodedMap whose correctness depends on what `from` looks like in practice. A small unit test feeding DecodedMap a few representative (sources, from) shapes — absolute file, nested, with '../' in sources — would pin the invariant and protect against future regressions of the resolve semantics.

review.summary: The one-line fix in DecodedMap is plausible but rests on an unstated invariant about the shape of `from`; that invariant should be written down and unit-tested rather than inferred from the snapshot diff. The new external-module source map path in test-run.ts is correct in spirit but UNDER-AUDITED on the performance axis: it does synchronous, unbounded, uncached file reads per stack frame during error reporting, which will bite on large node_modules with bundled vendor files. A small memoization cache and a size guard would move this from ASYMPTOTICALLY-OK-PRACTICALLY-SLOW to RIGOROUS. The '{}' fallback for missing maps is a reasonable defensive choice but silently swallows a real diagnostic and deserves a debug-log breadcrumb. Overall: ship-shaped, but tighten the invariants and add caching before this becomes a hot path.
